title: chore(ui): delete the inert objectui labeler config (F12, #25753)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2fSEGAKhWxTZd1rVNTsfqL)_

Part of #25753 (F12 from #25712's closing record 6432294556). Part of #25677.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 删除 `ui/.github/labeler.yml`。这是 `ui/.github/` 下仅剩的一个文件。
- **为什么改:** GitHub 只读根目录的 `.github/labeler.yml`,所以这份文件自 `ui/` 并入以来从未生效。按 4b 的测量,它的 32 个标签里有 28 个在本仓不存在。你在项目线程的 F12 决策卡上选了「删除」(2026-10-27 22:23Z)。
- **风险与回滚:** 没有运行时改动,也没有 CI 读这个文件。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** 无。改动不在受管路径上,席位走队列落地。

## What changes

`ui/.github/labeler.yml` is deleted (−167 lines), so `ui/.github/` no longer exists.

The file was inert. Root Auto Label (`pr-automation.yml`, `scripts/pr-labels.mjs`) reads only `.github/labeler.yml` at the repository root. The F12 = B ruling (2026-10-26) kept the file only until the label taxonomy was decided, and the maintainer has now chosen deletion.

No file reads it: `git grep` for `labeler` under `ui/` finds only path-string fixtures in `check-governed-queue-guard` (synthetic `.github/labeler.yml` paths, never read from disk), one description string in `dependabot-merge-gate.mjs`, and the F14 CI docs page, which gets its own card.

## Not in this PR

- The governed register row `ui-workflows` (`ui/.github/workflows/**`), its CODEOWNERS line and the AGENTS.md / pm-dispatch mentions stay. They guard the path against re-creation and do not depend on this file; changing them is Tier H.
- F14 (`ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`) gets its own card, per the maintainer's choice on that decision card.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 11 commands for this diff, and all 11 exit 0 on the head. Also run: `check-governed-merges --self-test` (0) and `dispatch-gates --tier` (no path-derived mandate, 167 changed lines). `check-governed-queue-guard` reads only a workflow event payload, so it runs in CI.

`skip-changeset`: nothing published changes.
